chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah and 'Abd Allah ibn Ja'far, both together, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, who said:

'Ali ibn Musa عليه السلام passed away while he was forty-nine years and some months old, in the year two hundred and two. He lived after Musa ibn Ja'far for twenty years, except for two months or three.

key_terms.عَاشَ بَعْدَ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ: he lived after Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُوسَى: Imam 'Ali ibn Musa al-Rida عليه السلام
key_terms.فِي عَامِ اثْنَيْنِ وَمِائَتَيْنِ: in the year two hundred and two
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death

ai.seo_question: When did Imam 'Ali ibn Musa al-Rida عليه السلام pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This report records the age and year of the passing of Imam 'Ali ibn Musa al-Rida عليه السلام. It also states the length of time he lived after Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام, preserving a concise biographical detail within the hadith tradition.
